about: The crown jewels of the SecuRAX estate: what, if lost or exposed, would stop everything (doc 84). Each one has an impact (1-5), whether it is a single point of failure, the live checks that show whether it is protected today, the one treatment that matters most, and the continuity scenario that recovers it. `./securax jewels` scores and ranks them every time it runs; the cockpit shows the top one. Edit this file, not the code.

jewels.name: Your data: chats, workflows, registers, the vault
jewels.why: Years of notes, risks, controls and conversations. Code can be rebuilt; this cannot.
jewels.treat: Encrypt every backup and keep a daily copy off the laptop

jewels.name: The backup key
jewels.why: Every encrypted backup opens only with it. Lose it and every backup is lost too.
jewels.treat: Keep a second copy away from the laptop and prove a backup opens with it every quarter

jewels.name: The code and its history
jewels.why: Everything runs from it. Today it lives on one laptop and one GitHub account.
jewels.treat: A second git host and a daily code bundle in the backups

jewels.name: The keys in .env (AI providers, the router, sync, the gateway)
jewels.why: Whoever holds them can spend your money and read your traffic.
jewels.treat: Replace the shipped default keys and keep .env readable only by you

jewels.name: The laptop itself
jewels.why: The only machine running the estate today: lose it and everything stops until a new one is set up.
jewels.treat: Off-site backups plus a recorded working version, so a new machine is running in hours

jewels.name: A version known to work
jewels.why: Without one, a bad change means debugging under pressure.
jewels.treat: Start the estate healthy once, so a working version is recorded and pinned

jewels.name: Access to AI models
jewels.why: Chat, building and the twin all need a model; one provider is one point of failure.
jewels.treat: At least two cloud providers on the build chain, with the local model as the floor

jewels.name: Your accounts (Google, Microsoft, GitHub, Tailscale, the clouds)
jewels.why: A lock-out stops sign-in, sync, updates or the site.
jewels.treat: Keep every recovery code in the estate's password manager

jewels.name: Free disk space
jewels.why: A full disk stops the databases.
jewels.treat: The 6-hourly clean-up and a phone alert when space is still short
